contract: Pure bounded v1 recipe callables as plain data: exact graph, agent and typed-decision declarations, six node kinds, typed slots, acyclic dependency and named-call graphs, explicit identity, bounded nesting and requirement-only rules. Encode preserves the original map; no execution or authority.
limits: Finite validation/composition scenarios only; no new Cure law selected, and reused proofs do not prove the recipe data format.
Host-approved schemas and truthful immutable schema, policy and binding identities; static checks cannot authenticate hashes or pre-bind runtime actions.
Accepted-data bounds do not bound schema compilation CPU or memory. Host must exclude secrets.
No I/O, clock, persistence, execution, scheduling, tool availability, schema subtyping, runtime readiness or authorization grant; agent and decision behavior remains elsewhere.

grounding.claim: Named groups three_callable_six_node_kinds, dependencies_and_data_slots, branches_and_outcomes, bounded_named_nesting, requirements_never_grant and stable_data_and_redaction exercise exact shapes, bounds, cycles, round-trip data, fixed errors, captured logs, actual authorization/approval composition and the checked example; finite scenarios, not a universal proof.

Compact scalar JSON encoding supplies byte counts after plain representation/depth checks; the ready DependencyGraph, PayloadSchema, Port, Authorization, Approval and PatternStep Contracts are reused unchanged.

Host-approved schema complexity, truthful identities, secret-free data and immutable revisions; consumers preserve checked values and invoke authorization/approval with trusted current exact-action context. Forged checked representations are outside the interface.

telemetry.contract: Pure validation emits no logs or observations.

config.contract: Intrinsic data operands and fixed v1 bounds; no ambient settings.
